entities.name: Laurine
entities.description: A human rogue from Innistrad, one of its most notorious graverobbers, loyal partner of Kamber.

entities.name: Kamber
entities.description: Laurine's partner, a graverobber transformed into a vampire in a thousand-year-old vampire's tomb.

events.summary: Kamber was transformed in the tomb of a thousand-year-old vampire.
events.quote: Kamber was transformed before the two could escape

relations.quote: She and her partner Kamber are the plane's most notorious graverobbers
